packet.title: Stylesheet AST (design) — Early
packet.summary: Designs the index-addressed stylesheet AST in src/xslt_ast_internal.h: declarations and instructions with compiled attributes, each element’s static context, import precedence and source locations.

body.p: After the Phase 1 gate. Owns src/xslt_ast_internal.h. Declarations and instructions over the parsed arena tree, index-addressed (, style): element kind, attributes as AST indexes of compiled XPath, patterns or value templates, the static context of each element (namespaces, xpath-default-namespace, expand-text, default-collation, default-mode, version, exclude-result-prefixes), import precedence, source locations. Done when the stylesheet of for-each-group-001, a template rule and an xsl:function are written out in comments. Done 2026-10-17 (): src/xslt_ast_internal.h, header only; the builder and lifecycle functions go to 4.5 in a new src/xslt_ast.c.
